turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's essay. What happened?
I entered the zero before calling you. That was my mistake, and I own it.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and what did you have when you did?
Here's the version history. Created October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. He could have drafted it somewhere else and pasted it in. And you still haven't told me who decided on the zero.
And his outline argued cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Show me the outline. Whose handwriting, and what date is on it?
Procedure 4.4 allows a private supervised rewrite. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4, and I'll want it in writing. You still haven't shown me the outline.
Can I ask you a few questions about Owen's habits at home?
No. I'm not a witness here, and Owen's home isn't your evidence. The outline. Where is it?
Does he usually work late?
He's seventeen. Next question. Show me the outline.
Does anyone help him with his homework?
Not answering that either. The outline, Hale.
You keep not answering me.
You haven't answered me either. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
So the rewrite is agreed?
No. Agreeing to a rewrite means agreeing there's something to rewrite for, and I haven't seen the outline. Show it to me, and answer who decided.
Are you sure you're okay with it?
Ten minutes. I'm not here to be asked how I feel about it. Where's the outline?
I just want to be clear on the terms.
Here's what I want. The zero comes off today, nothing goes on his record, and I get all of it in writing tonight. Before I agree to anything else, I see that outline.
Can you say them back to me one more time?
You wrote it down or you didn't. Zero off, his record clean, all of it in an email tonight. And the outline.
And you won't change your mind tonight?
Not because you ask me twice. Show me something I can check.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, nothing placed on Owen's record, and the outline you described put in front of me. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, his record clean, and the outline shown, all in writing tonight; the private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4 is the fair outcome, and you named it, but she never accepted it, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Owning that the zero went in before you called her got you a flat okay and stopped her attacking, because it took away part of her procedure complaint.
What cost ground: You described an outline arguing cowardice but never showed it, so the strongest piece of your case stayed a claim she could not check, and you never answered her question about who decided on the zero.
What she never said: One night in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night times on October 28, came close to that night, which is why she went shorter and straight to procedure, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked who decided on the zero, answer it plainly in one sentence and then put the outline on the table, so the rewrite is offered with evidence she can check behind it.
